organizationSettings.orgNameAm: የደርጋጅ ማህበረሰብ አንድነት እና በጎ አድራጎት ማህበር
organizationSettings.slogan: United in Unity, Serving Humanity, Building Our Future.
organizationSettings.sloganAm: በአንድነት ለወገናችን፣ በመተሳሰብ ለአካባቢያችን፣ በትብብር ለትውልዳችን!
organizationSettings.aboutHistory: Dergag Community Unity & Charity Association was founded by dedicated elders, community representatives, and youth from the Dergag area to foster solidarity, social welfare, humanitarian relief, and grassroots local development.
organizationSettings.aboutHistoryAm: የደርጋጅ ማህበረሰብ አንድነት እና በጎ አድራጎት ማህበር በአካባቢው የሀገር ሽማግሌዎች፣ ወጣቶችና ተወላጆች ጥረት የተቋቋመ ሲሆን፤ ዋና ዓላማውም የማህበረሰብ አንድነትን ማጠናከር፣ አቅመ ደካሞችን መደገፍና የአካባቢውን ሁለንተናዊ ልማት ማፋጠን ነው::
organizationSettings.mission: To unite all members of the Dergag community and supporters, delivering transparent humanitarian relief, education, healthcare aid, and sustainable development.
organizationSettings.missionAm: የደርጋጅ ተወላጆችንና በጎ አድራጊዎችን በማስተባበር በበጎ አድራጎት፣ በትምህርት፣ በጤና፣ በማህበራዊ ደህንነት እና በልማት ስራዎች የህብረተሰቡን ኑሮ ማሻሻል::
organizationSettings.vision: To see an empowered, interconnected, culturally rich, and self-sufficient Dergag community where every family thrives with dignity.
organizationSettings.visionAm: የተሳሰረ፣ እርስ በርስ የሚረዳዳ፣ በኢኮኖሚና ማህበራዊ መስክ የበለጸገ እና ባህሉን የጠበቀ ጠንካራ የደርጋጅ ማህበረሰብ ማየት::
organizationSettings.address: Dergag Center Office & Addis Ababa Liaison Branch (Bole Sub-City), Ethiopia

projects.title: Dergag Community Clean Drinking Water Initiative
projects.titleAm: የደርጋጅ አካባቢ ንጹህ የመጠጥ ውሃ ፕሮጀክት
projects.description: Drilling modern boreholes and establishing protected distribution points to provide clean, potable water for over 3,500 rural households, drastically reducing waterborne diseases.
projects.descriptionAm: ለ3,500 አባወራዎች ንጹህ የመጠጥ ውሃ ተደራሽ ለማድረግ ጥልቅ የውሃ ጉድጓድ ቁፋሮ እና የማከፋፈያ መስመር ግንባታ ስራ::
projects.impactReport: Phase 1 hydrological survey and shallow drilling completed successfully. Civil works on reservoir tank underway with 65% local community labor participation.

projects.title: Dergag Primary School Library & ICT Lab Renovation
projects.titleAm: የደርጋጅ መጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ቤተ-መጽሐፍትና ኮምፒውተር ማዕከል
projects.description: Comprehensive renovation of two learning blocks, supplying 2,400 reference textbooks, 15 modern computer workstations, and solar backup power for 600 students.
projects.descriptionAm: ለ600 ተማሪዎች ምቹ የንባብ ቦታ ለመፍጠር ሁለት የመማሪያ ክፍሎችን በማደስ፣ 2,400 የማጣቀሻ መጽሐፍትና 15 ኮምፒውተሮችን የማሟላት ፕሮጀክት::
projects.impactReport: Handed over to school administration. Student reading hours increased by 140%, and basic computer literacy program now running every afternoon.

projects.title: Vulnerable Elders & Orphans Seasonal Welfare Support
projects.titleAm: የአቅመ ደካማ አረጋውያንና ወላጅ አልባ ህጻናት ድጋፍ
projects.description: Quarterly food security hampers (teff, wheat, cooking oil) and warm blankets for 120 destitute elders and full annual educational sponsorship for 45 orphan children.
projects.descriptionAm: ለ120 የተቸገሩ አረጋውያን የምግብና አልባሳት ድጋፍ እንዲሁም ለ45 ወላጅ አልባ ህጻናት ሙሉ የትምህርት ቁሳቁስ ድጋፍ የማድረግ ዘላቂ መርሃ-ግብር::
projects.impactReport: Over 240 food packs distributed in the last two quarters. 100% of sponsored children retained in school with improved academic results.

projects.title: Community Health Clinic Medical Equipment Support
projects.titleAm: የጤና ኬላ የህክምና ቁሳቁስ ማሟያ ፕሮጀክት
projects.description: Equipping the local health station with maternity delivery beds, diagnostic ultrasound, patient monitoring tools, and emergency solar vaccine refrigeration.
projects.descriptionAm: የአካባቢውን የጤና ጣቢያ በወሊድ አልጋዎች፣ በምርመራ መሳሪያዎችና የክትባት ማቀዝቀዣዎች በማደራጀት የእናቶችና ህጻናት ጤናን የማሻሻል ተግባር::
projects.impactReport: Maternity wing upgrade in progress; medical suppliers contracted for delivery.

charityCampaigns.title: Emergency Medical Support for Sister Rahel Girma
charityCampaigns.titleAm: ለእህታችን ራሔል ግርማ ህክምና አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ጥሪ
charityCampaigns.description: Urgent humanitarian medical fundraising for heart valve replacement surgery verified by Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital cardiology board.
charityCampaigns.descriptionAm: በጥቁር አንበሳ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል ለተረጋገጠ የልብ ቀዶ ጥገና ህክምና የሚያስፈልገውን ወጪ ለመሸፈን የቀረበ የተረጋገጠ የበጎ አድራጎት ጥሪ::
charityCampaigns.targetBeneficiary: Sister Rahel Girma (32, mother of two)

charityCampaigns.title: Dergag Orphan Student Educational Sponsorship Fund
charityCampaigns.titleAm: የደርጋጅ ወላጅ አልባ ተማሪዎች ዓመታዊ የትምህርት ድጋፍ ፈንድ
charityCampaigns.description: Annual sponsorship fund providing uniforms, exercise books, bags, shoes, and monthly stipends for 50 high-achieving orphan children in Dergag.
charityCampaigns.descriptionAm: ለ50 ወላጅ አልባ ጎበዝ ተማሪዎች የደንብ ልብስ፣ የደብተርና የትምህርት መርጃ ቁሳቁስ እንዲሁም ወርሃዊ ድጎማ ለማቅረብ የተዘጋጀ ፈንድ::

announcements.title: Official Launch of the Dergag Unity Web Platform
announcements.titleAm: የደርጋጅ አንድነትና በጎ አድራጎት ማህበር ይፋዊ ድረ-ገጽ ምረቃ
announcements.content: We are pleased to announce the official launch of our comprehensive community platform. Members worldwide can now register online, inspect ongoing projects, and contribute transparently.
announcements.contentAm: የማህበራችንን አሰራር ይበልጥ ግልጽ፣ ፈጣን እና ተደራሽ ለማድረግ የተዘጋጀው ዘመናዊ ድረ-ገጽ ዛሬ በይፋ ስራ ጀምሯል:: በመላው አለም የሚገኙ የደርጋጅ ተወላጆች በቀላሉ አባል መሆንና የልማት ስራዎችን መከታተል ይችላሉ::
announcements.author: Executive Committee

announcements.title: Quarterly Community Assembly & Transparency Briefing
announcements.titleAm: የሩብ ዓመት የማህበረሰብ አጠቃላይ ጉባዔና የግልጽነት ሪፖርት
announcements.content: The executive leadership invites all registered members and supporters to participate in our upcoming general assembly to review financial audits, ongoing water projects, and youth initiatives.
announcements.contentAm: የስራ አስፈጻሚ ኮሚቴው የሩብ ዓመቱን የኦዲትና የፕሮጀክት አፈጻጸም ሪፖርት ለአባላት የሚያቀርብበት ጠቅላላ ጉባዔ በቀጣይ ሳምንት ይካሄዳል:: ሁሉም አባላት እንዲገኙ ጥሪያችንን እናስተላልፋለን::
announcements.author: Secretariat Office

announcements.title: Successful Handover of Primary School Learning Materials
announcements.titleAm: የትምህርት ቁሳቁስ ድጋፍ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ለተማሪዎች ተሰራጨ
announcements.content: Over 2,400 exercise books, educational charts, and backpacks were successfully handed over to Dergag Primary School students in the presence of local education bureau officials.
announcements.contentAm: በማህበሩ በጎ አድራጊ አባላት የተሰበሰቡ የትምህርት መርጃ ቁሳቁሶች ለደርጋጅ መጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ተማሪዎች በደማቅ ሁኔታ ተበርክተዋል::
announcements.author: Education Committee

events.title: Annual Dergag Unity General Assembly 2026
events.titleAm: የ2026 ዓመታዊ የደርጋጅ አንድነት ጠቅላላ ጉባዔ
events.description: Annual gathering of all community members to evaluate annual achievements, review audited financial statements, and elect new committee chairpersons.
events.descriptionAm: የማህበሩን ዓመታዊ የኦዲት ሪፖርት ለማድመጥ፣ ቀጣይ የልማት እቅዶችን ለማጽደቅ እና አዳዲስ የስራ መሪዎችን ለመምረጥ የተዘጋጀ ታላቅ ጠቅላላ ጉባዔ::

events.title: Green Legacy Tree Planting & Watershed Protection Day
events.titleAm: የአረንጓዴ አሻራ ችግኝ ተከላና ተፋሰስ ጥበቃ ዘመቻ
events.description: Volunteer mobilization day to plant 10,000 indigenous trees around Dergag spring catchment areas to protect soil fertility and conserve local water sources.
events.descriptionAm: የደርጋጅ ተፋሰስ አካባቢዎችን ከአፈር መሸርሸር ለመጠበቅና የውሃ ምንጮችን ለመንከባከብ 10,000 የሀገር በቀል ችግኞችን የመትከል የጋራ ዘመቻ::

events.title: Medical Camp & Mother-Child Health Screening (Past)
events.titleAm: የነጻ ህክምና እና የእናቶችና ህጻናት ምርመራ መርሐ-ግብር
events.description: Volunteer doctors and nurses provided free general health checkups, hypertension screening, and eye care for over 450 rural residents.
events.descriptionAm: በበጎ ፈቃደኛ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የተካሄደ የነጻ ህክምና አገልግሎት፤ ከ450 በላይ ነዋሪዎች የምርመራና የመድሃኒት ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል::
